Lars"},{"spec_id":"spec_0784","text":"Mornin' folks 🤠

So, starting Monday I'm gonna put a little 15-min huddle on the books, 8:00-8:15 every weekday, video link here: [link]. Invite's going out to the whole crew — Nico, Andre, Ulla, Kemi, Zoe, Liam, plus the dispatch desk and both yard leads, so eleven of us all told.

Figured we'd just go around the horn like usual. Everybody gives their bit — what you hauled yesterday, what's on the docket today, anything snagging you. Nico, you can kick us off with the overnight dock counts since you're up earliest anyhow. Andre and Ulla, y'all can do the carrier updates back to back. Kemi, same weekly routing numbers you post in the channel, just read 'em out loud for us. Zoe and Liam, whatever you've got going on Nutmeg 2.0 testing — the scanner glitch at bay 4 has been eating everyone's lunch so I'd love for us to actually chew on that one for a few minutes while we're all there.

If you can't make it just drop your update in the thread here [link] or in the tracker [link], no harm no foul.

I know 15 minutes with eleven folks is tight, so let's keep it moving like a well-oiled forklift. If we run over we run over.

Holler if the time's rough for anybody — I know the yard boys start early.

Thanks y'all,
Erik"},{"spec_id":"spec_0785","text":"Subject: All-Hands: Quill Rollout — What's Changing and Your Questions
